probes.name: artist-identity-errors
probes.message: artists with a persisted Soundcharts error
probes.sql: SELECT artist_id, left(last_error, 120) AS error FROM artist_external_identities WHERE last_error <> ''

probes.name: lander-soundcharts-error
probes.message: Lander Records Soundcharts sync error persisted
probes.sql: SELECT left(soundcharts_last_error, 120) AS error FROM lander_records_integration_settings WHERE soundcharts_last_error <> ''

probes.name: spotify-error
probes.sql: SELECT left(spotify_last_error, 120) AS error FROM lander_records_integration_settings WHERE spotify_last_error <> ''
